query.text: 请帮我看着孩子写字，如果他坐姿不端正，请帮我纠正。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child writing, and help me correct him if his posture is poor.

annotation.text_zh: 请端正坐姿，不要趴在桌上写字。
annotation.text_en: Sit up straight and don't slouch over the desk while writing.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
